edits.value_json: {"text":"The blue feather flag fluttered above the clocktower while the neighbor watched from below. Pip hugged the bell rope. He was sure his sneeze—and any chime—would boom like a thunder-cupcake. Ada lifted the red ribbon. \u201cThen we shall begin with a club-sized sound,\u201d she said.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"blue","at":"initial"},{"key":"neighbor.awake","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes.sneeze_loud","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]}

{"text":"The blue feather flag waved above the clocktower, and the neighbor was awake below. Pip puffed out his cheeks, ready for a grand first chime. Ada tied the red ribbon to the club notebook. \u201cLet us discover what sort of hello the bell prefers,\u201d she said, as Mr. Bellweather jingled the wooden key.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"blue","at":"initial"},{"key":"neighbor.awake","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes.sneeze_loud","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"}]}

{"text":"Ada leaned beneath the dusty gears and discovered that the feather flag was red. \u201cRed means something is happening!\u201d she said, while its tail tickled her ear.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"red","at":"after"}]}
